user_query: Analyze this amino acid sequence: report basic sequence properties, closest Swiss-Prot homologs and their annotated functions, catalytic activity, cofactors, pathways, localization, subunit/GO annotations, and Pfam domains if available. Clearly distinguish sequence-derived prediction and homology inference from experimentally curated evidence.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Endonuclease that removes tRNA introns. Cleaves pre-tRNA at the 5'- and 3'-splice sites to release the intron. The products are an intron and two tRNA half-molecules bearing 2',3' cyclic phosphate and 5'-OH termini. Recognizes a pseudosymmetric substrate in which 2 bulged loops of 3 bases are separated by a stem of 4 bp.

catalytic_activity.equation: pretRNA = a 3'-half-tRNA molecule with a 5'-OH end + a 5'-half-tRNA molecule with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate end + an intron with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate and a 5'-hydroxyl terminus.
catalytic_activity.raw_annotation:
<ns0:comment xmlns:ns0="https://uniprot.org/uniprot" type="catalytic activity">
        <ns0:reaction evidence="1">
            <ns0:text>pretRNA = a 3'-half-tRNA molecule with a 5'-OH end + a 5'-half-tRNA molecule with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate end + an intron with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate and a 5'-hydroxyl terminus.</ns0:text>
            <ns0:dbReference type="EC" id="4.6.1.16" />
        </ns0:reaction>
    </ns0:comment>

subunit: Homotetramer; although the tetramer contains four active sites, only two participate in the cleavage. Therefore, it should be considered as a dimer of dimers.
similarity: Belongs to the tRNA-intron endonuclease family. Archaeal short subfamily.

function: Endonuclease that removes tRNA introns. Cleaves pre-tRNA at the 5'- and 3'-splice sites to release the intron. The products are an intron and two tRNA half-molecules bearing 2',3' cyclic phosphate and 5'-OH termini. Recognizes a pseudosymmetric substrate in which 2 bulged loops of 3 bases are separated by a stem of 4 bp.

catalytic_activity.equation: pretRNA = a 3'-half-tRNA molecule with a 5'-OH end + a 5'-half-tRNA molecule with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate end + an intron with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate and a 5'-hydroxyl terminus.

subunit: Homotetramer; although the tetramer contains four active sites, only two participate in the cleavage. Therefore, it should be considered as a dimer of dimers.
similarity: Belongs to the tRNA-intron endonuclease family. Archaeal short subfamily.
